source.name: Warosu Database Backup 2025-08-15
source.short-desc: Database backup of warosu.org on 2025-08-15 in mysqldump (SQL statements) format
source.capture: 12 per-board mysqldumps, shipped as loose .sql.zst files (no zip on the IA item)

prepare.name: decompress the zstd per-board dumps
prepare.run: mkdir -p extracted && find source -name '*.sql.zst' | while read -r f; do o=extracted/$(basename "${f%.zst}"); [ -e "$o" ] || unzstd -q -o "$o" "$f"; done

prepare.name: stage the .sql dumps for ingest
prepare.run: mkdir -p out && find extracted -name '*.sql' -exec sh -c 'cp -al "$1" out/ 2>/dev/null || cp -a "$1" out/' _ {} ';'
